scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=shared && npm run test --workspace=server
